claim: A VPC's IPv6 CIDR blocks can be sized from /44 to /60 in increments of /4, and an IPv6 subnet can be sized from /44 to /64 in increments of /4; you can associate a single IPv6 CIDR block when you create a new VPC.

values.spoken: VPC: slash forty-four to slash sixty
subnet: slash forty-four to slash sixty-four

qualifiers.scope: per VPC IPv6 CIDR block and per IPv6 subnet

note: Tiered IPv6 sizes arrived November 16, 2023 (What's New, blocked by robots.txt; date from the change feed). Older material knows only a /56 VPC block and /64 subnets. The number of IPv6 CIDR blocks per VPC is an adjustable quota: use vpc-size-ipv4-vs-ipv6-cidrs.
